Reference / crypto/rsa

crypto/rsa#

RSA (RFC 8017) over the host provider (aws-lc: constant-time, blinded private operations).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

RsaPssSigning(key, RsaHash.sha256, entropy)   // RSASSA-PSS, salt = hash length
RsaPkcs1Signing(key, RsaHash.sha256)          // RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5
RsaOaepEncryption(public, RsaHash.sha256, entropy).encrypted(message)
RsaOaepDecryption(key, RsaHash.sha256, entropy).decrypted(ciphertext)

Description#

RSA (RFC 8017) over the host provider (aws-lc: constant-time, blinded private operations). Generated keys are 2048, 3072 or 4096 bits; imported PKCS#8 keys 2048 to 8192. The entropy arguments are kept for the API: key generation, PSS salts and OAEP padding draw from the provider's own CSPRNG, so Entropy.fake() does not make them reproducible. RsaPrivateKey(bits:, entropy:) generates once at construction (seconds for 4096 bits); RsaPrivateKey(pkcs8: ...) takes DER PKCS#8. Signing and encryption are explicit schemes over a key and a hash:

Verifying keys answer false for invalid signatures; failed OAEP decryption is AuthenticationFailed without distinguishing padding errors.
